{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_arm = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute the fraction who responded
fraction_responded = treatment_arm['responded'].mean()

# Round to 3 decimal places for reporting
fraction_rounded = round(fraction_responded, 3)

# Print only the rounded fraction — this is the only number we need to report
print(fraction_rounded)"}
